Name: Prislee -  Mail From Seb
Author: prismaticlee
Description: This mail adds mod that you can get from Sebastian. Whether or not you receive the different mail he has depends on your heart level, if you've viewed friendship events, dating status, or skill levels. Sometimes, a combo of 2 is needed (so far, the only combo is dating/marriage and hearts, hearts & their events, and friendship level & skill level). More will be added soon, as I hope to expand upon this and create even more mail you can get from him.

Downloads.Description: Main, official file (previous was placeholder to make sure things worked). i18n folder is a key for you to use for translations if making one

Manifest.Name: Even More Seb Mail
Manifest.Description: Mail from Seb! Some triggered by heart events, other by skills, or just friendship level.
